'''Yanshu''' {{Lang|zh=烟舒}} is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] first mentioned in {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}} and first appears in {{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}}.

Her late husband, [[Sandao]], was a [[Nethermancer]].<ref>{{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}}
:'''Yanshu:''' There are fewer Nethermancers each year. Few in that line meet a peaceful end. My late husband, Sandao, was no different... He did not even leave me a keepsake.</ref>
